name: @projexlight/sdk-workflow
summary: Durable workflow engine for ProjexCloud: declare a Definition once (ordered steps + signals + compensations), start Runs against it, send Signals from external events, and the engine resumes after crashes / replays from journals. Backed by Postgres in dev and Temporal-shaped in production. Used for FNOL → settlement, tenant offboard pipeline, multi-step onboard, dunning advance — anywhere the work spans more time / failures than a single request can hold.

endpoints.description: Register a workflow definition (steps + signal hooks + compensation handlers). Validates that every step has an in-process handler.
Start a Run of a definition. Returns run_id; the engine handles all subsequent execution.
Deliver a signal to a paused Run (e.g. 'approval-granted', 'payment-cleared'). Wakes the Run up if it was awaiting.
Inspect a Run's state, history, current step, and any pending compensations.

events.name: workflow.run.started.v1
events.description: New run started; carries input + correlation key.

events.name: workflow.step.completed.v1
events.description: A step finished; carries step output for replay.

events.name: workflow.run.completed.v1
events.description: Final step done; run terminated normally.

events.name: workflow.run.failed.v1
events.description: Unrecoverable step error after retries exhausted. Compensations fire automatically.

events.name: workflow.compensation.fired.v1
events.description: A compensation step ran after a failure; saga rollback trail.

models.description: Static definition: name, version, step_specs (ordered), signal_specs, compensation_specs.
Per-execution state: current_step, status (running / waiting-signal / completed / failed), input, output, started_at.
Per-step execution row: started_at, completed_at, attempt, output. Append-only journal supports replay.
Per-failed-step compensation row: original step ref, compensation_handler_name, fired_at, succeeded.

hooks.name: registerStep
hooks.description: Register an in-process step handler. Must be called at boot before any definition referencing the step can register.

hooks.name: registerSignalHandler
hooks.description: Wire a signal-spec to a handler. Signals can short-circuit waiting Runs.

hooks.name: registerCompensation
hooks.description: Wire a step to its compensation. If the step fails, the compensation runs as part of the saga rollback.

hooks.name: startEngine
hooks.description: Boot the worker that drives Runs forward. Polls workflow.run for state=running rows; safe to leave running in dev.

scenarios.title: Insurance claim — FNOL → triage → review → settle
scenarios.when_to_use: Multi-day, multi-actor process where steps await human decisions + provider responses. The workflow engine survives restarts + retries.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Engine drives runs through steps. The await-review step pauses until /api/workflows/:run_id/signal delivers the adjuster's decision. On settle failure, the compensation refunds the partial settlement before marking the run failed.

scenarios.title: Start a Run programmatically
scenarios.when_to_use: External trigger (e.g. customer files a claim) starts a Run with structured input.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns run_id. Emits workflow.run.started.v1. correlation_key lets downstream lookups find the run without storing the id.

scenarios.title: Deliver a signal to wake a paused Run
scenarios.when_to_use: Adjuster clicks Approve in tenant-admin → the gateway delivers the signal to the paused await-review step.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The waitForSignal in the await-review step resolves with the payload. Engine advances to settle. Audit chain shows the full trail.

scenarios.title: Saga compensation fires when a downstream step fails
scenarios.when_to_use: Payment refused after partial fulfilment. The compensation undoes the work the prior steps committed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Emits workflow.run.failed.v1 + a workflow.compensation.fired.v1 per compensation. Customer-visible state shows the failure with the compensation trail attached.

scenarios.title: Operator inspects a stuck Run
scenarios.when_to_use: Run isn't advancing; operator needs to see what step it's on + why.
scenarios.example_code:
const r = await fetch(`/api/workflows/${run_id}`, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + jwt } });
const { status, current_step, history, pending_compensations } = (await r.json()).data;
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the full state. Common reasons for stuck: status='waiting-signal' (no signal delivered yet), or status='running' with retry_after_at in the future (transient error backoff).

compliance_posture.notes: Append-only step journal supports SOX 'evidence of design + operating effectiveness' for any process the workflow models. 21 CFR Part 11 met by hash-chained step rows + signing on terminal status. Compensations are themselves auditable steps — they don't bypass the audit chain.
